title: carlina acanthifolia subsp. cynara
intro: Carlina acanthifolia subsp. cynara, commonly known as the Cynara, is a plant species in the daisy family Asteraceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and hepatoprotective actions. The bioactive constituents of Carlina acanthifolia subsp. cynara include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions. The health benefits of Carlina acanthifolia subsp. cynara may include antioxidant activity, anti-inflammatory effects, and potential protection against liver damage.
